name: kzarzycki-agent-skills
description: Krzysztof Zarzycki's plugins for Claude Code. Descriptions here stay plugin-level on purpose — individual skills change too often to enumerate, and self-describe once a plugin is installed.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server (browser automation + scriptable Playwright code execution) plus a skill teaching efficient agent-driven use. The MCP equivalent of playwright-cli.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Durable, human-gated engineering workflows for Claude Code: a Spec → Tech Design pipeline where each phase converges through a format gate and independent reviewers before a human approval gate, plus subagent orchestration and learning consolidation.

plugins.name: utilities
plugins.description: Standalone utility skills for Claude Code, independent of any one workflow — e.g. searching past Claude Code sessions by topic.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Deep-research orchestration for Claude Code: parallel multi-source web search that produces cited reports, plus delegation to hosted research assistants.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Engineering toolkit for Claude Code: safely vetting and adopting third-party code, and capturing a project's conventions.

plugins.name: content
plugins.description: Content-preparation toolkit for Claude Code: understanding and reproducing a person's writing voice for outreach, content, and proposals.

plugins.name: experimental
plugins.description: Experimental skills under active iteration. CONTRACT: anything here may change, break, or be removed at any time and is NOT held to the stability or versioning guarantees of the other plugins — opt in accordingly. Skills graduate to a stable plugin once their shape settles.

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.description: Google Workspace skills for Claude Code, sourced upstream from github.com/googleworkspace/cli (tracks upstream, no local copy). Broad coverage across Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Slides and more. Every skill shells out to the locally installed `gws` binary; requires `gws` installed and authenticated (`brew install googleworkspace-cli`).

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's 'Skills for Real Engineers' — small, composable engineering and productivity skills, loaded directly from upstream (no local copy vendored).

plugins.name: dagu
plugins.description: Dagu workflow orchestration skill, sourced upstream from github.com/dagucloud/dagu (tracks upstream, no local copy).

plugins.name: goal-creator
plugins.description: Compiles plain-language work into concise, host-aware, verifiable /goal-style agent contracts (done state, proof, constraints, stop policy, completion receipt) for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents. Sourced upstream from github.com/mysticaltech/goal-creator-skill (tracks upstream, no local copy).

plugins.name: project-templates
plugins.description: Scaffold new repositories from Copier templates with sensible engineering conventions baked in (git, pinned pre-commit/commit-msg/pre-push hooks, CLAUDE.md, CI, language toolchain). Provides the bootstrap-project skill that auto-triggers on 'new project' intent. Sourced from github.com/kzarzycki/project-templates.
